additionalInformation: This course is the gateway course for all major and minor programmes offered by the Department of Food Science and Technology. Course content is delivered via multiple short videos each week. Students are expected to watch the videos and read recommended chapters in the textbook before the in-person workshop to discuss relevant topics or questions in small groups. Project work is also included starting from AY25/26 Sem 2.
description: This course provides an overview of the field of Food Science and Technology by first introducing non-technical discussion of food related issues and concerns currently and in the foreseeable future. Following this, the different types of commercial food products in the marketplace from raw fresh foods to processed foods will be discussed with the introduction of some relevant technical terms. The role of a food scientist or technologist becomes apparent to ensure the quality, safety and variety of foods to cater for different needs of the society. It wraps up with the primary subdisciplines of Food Science and Technology.
